user.title: Add a saved transit route
user.description:
> [!NOTE]
> The resulting sensor fetches once when the integration loads, then never polls again — by design, to protect the free API quota. To refresh it afterwards, call the `homeassistant.update_entity` action targeting the sensor, e.g. from a time or zone automation. See the [README](https://github.com/msberends/ha-google-transit-routes#usage-sensors) for details.
